caption: The drawing depicts an item with two main bulbous, pouch-like sections connected by a short, narrow neck, each end of the neck fitted with a metallic, silver-colored band. The pouches are primarily a muted reddish-pink color, decorated with patterns made up of small, dark beads or stitches arranged into repeated geometric and floral motifs. One pouch has a green band featuring intricate designs near its opening, transitioning to a reddish-pink section, while the other pouch features a wide brown band with a row of lighter designs flanked by additional blue-beaded motifs. At the bottom of one pouch, dark beaded tassels extend outward in multiple strands. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional elements depicted.
title: Beaded Purse
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
